selection_basis: Previously retained reserve issue before solver trials; evaluated for closed-bug/source-grounding eligibility only. No solver output or potential zg score used to select this candidate.

closed_bug.classification_basis: Bug-report title plus documented wrong query results and linked maintainer fix; do not rely on a bug label.

merged_fix.linkage: PR body says fix #583; issue timeline cross-references PR and maintainer comment confirms fix. Issue closed event has null commit_id and is not alone used as commit proof.

precise_pre_fix_parent.why_not_pr_base: Use the actual single parent of the merged fix; PR head/base differ because independent Xcode/libtool fix #581 intervened.

neutral_observable_scenario.scope: FTS plus scalar filters only; string equality and integer range, scalar-only/positive/disjoint/unindexed controls. No function names, rootcause, issue/PR reference or fix hints in solver question.

limitations: No solver, CI, build, or native reproduction was run for this candidate. The reported observations come from the issue; applicability to the exact pre-fix parent is source-inspected, not independently executed.
The issue reports reproduction on 0.5.1 and a related source checkout, not on the chosen actual merge-parent SHA.

The public issue contains rootcause speculation and the public PR exposes the fix. Mount only source/ plus the neutral question for any future solver run; keep provenance/, evaluator/, hashes with identifying metadata and Git history outside its access. Network retrieval of issue/fix would leak the answer.
Authentic tests and comments already present at the pre-fix revision remain in the source export, including empty candidate fallback behavior; do not selectively delete them.
A newer public repository does not establish absence from training data. No contamination guarantee is made.
Scope deliberately excludes hybrid/vector-only causal claims. FTS branch leakage may contribute to a hybrid union, but the identical-looking vector filter line does not prove vector-only leakage.
Eligibility establishes a usable draft, not demonstrated difficulty, generalization or stable zg benefit. Later pilot inclusion would require an explicit fixed protocol and all outcomes retained.
gold_audit_note: Follow frozen source and merged patch over reporter rootcause speculation; specific corrections are recorded in evaluator/rubric-draft.json.
